/simplify pass: before vs after (2026-10-14)

Captured with Playwright against HEAD (9ccaa40) and the working tree, same seeded demo data. Most of the pass was internal, and the pages below show no visual change unless marked.

Repository detail: Re-analyze confirm

The detail page now uses the same confirm dialog as the grid, via RepositoryCommandClient.ConfirmReanalyzeAsync. Its own copy, with shorter wording, was deleted.

Repositories

No visual change. Status badges now come from RepositoryGridRow.Status, and the comparison chart no longer redraws on every progress frame.

Global Insights

No visual change. The heatmap range picker is now the shared ChartRangeSelector, and the outlier hint (only shown when outliers exist) no longer points at the removed ignore-patterns editor.

Settings

No visual change. Save now keeps stored ignore patterns (Reset to Defaults + Save used to delete them), and the save toast says 'extensions' instead of 'extensions or globs'.
